messages:
maya: Heads-up — starting a compactification pass on the new q6b promptset to reduce token bloat before the quant evals. Goal: -10% median prompt length without losing golden coverage.

alex: Nice. What's the plan for de-dupe thresholds? we should avoid pruning golden anchors.

maya: We'll run a two-stage filter: 1) fuzzyhash dedupe at 0.88 similarity, 2) semantic embed cluster prune keeping top-3 highest-entropy anchors per cluster. Golden GUIDs are whitelisted.

dmitri: Can you drop the fuzzyhash command you'll run? I'll mirror it on the staging sampler.

maya: Sure — running:```bash
curate-cli compactify --input s3://redwood/promptset/q6b/raw --out s3://redwood/promptset/q6b/compact-v1 
  --fuzzy-thresh 0.88 --embed-cluster 0.7 --keep-gold-file s3://redwood/promptset/q6b/golden_whitelist.tsv
```

simon: After compactify, we should snapshot a small canary (5k) with old vs new prompts and run both through q6b-int4 and q6b-int8 to catch quality deltas. I can queue the evals.

audrey: Labeling ops: if the compact step reassigns any prompt to a different bucket we need to hold them out from automatic relabel for 48h. We had a spike when relabels overlapped with canaries last time.

labeler-bot: @audrey noted — creating holdout tag on any sample with bucket_change=true for 48h. tag_id=holdout_374555

alex: For the quant evals, track both accuracy (NDCG@5 and classifier pass rates) and hallucination regressions (span-level F1 vs gold). If delta > 2% on any, we block rollout.

maya: Ack. I'm also enabling kvcache-preserve mode — should reduce variance in long context tasks. Command flag: --kv-preserve true.

dmitri: ETA for compact-v1 artifacts? I can start staging runs after upload.

maya: Upload should finish in ~30m (upload + dedupe). I'll post the artifact link when done.

simon: Once we have canary results I'll run a quick cost/latency delta: tokens/sec and p99 tail. If int4 shows small perf gain but quality regresses, we hold.

audrey: Labeler team on standby for quick adjudication of any degenerate cases. Ping me if >50 samples flagged.

maya: Uploaded: s3://redwood/promptset/q6b/compact-v1 — kickoff evals now. Canaries: 5k-old vs 5k-compact, run ids queued: eval-374555-A (int4), eval-374555-B (int8).

alex: Thanks — I'll watch eval-374555-A and post metrics. :eyes: 

labeler-bot: Eval jobs started: eval-374555-A, eval-374555-B. ETA ~45m. Progress updates will post to #eng-ml-evals.

maya: If anything looks off, we rollback compactification and re-run with 0.9 fuzzy thresh. Prefer conservative.

simon: Sounds good. I'll aggregate the metrics into a short dashboard once both jobs finish.

audrey: Also: remind ops to not auto-archive old prompt IDs until holdout_374555 expires.

maya: Noted. Thanks everyone.
